name: Amanda Amamiya
source:
Amanda used to be Primavera's number one call girl before Stella's introduction to fame. After Rose was chosen as the new Madam, the position which Amanda hoped to attain, she began to work behind the scenes, still trying to cling to the title 'Madam'

[source: TV Tropes]
